integrity.computational_reproduction: Python standard-library exhaustive check n=3 through n=8; full automorphism checks n=3 through n=6; no finite-data inference for general n.
integrity.mathematical_basis: Two exact good-cover nerve reductions, with natural integral homology actions.

limitations: Only bounded induced components of size at most two and n>=4 crown graphs are classified.
Only homology is asserted equivariantly; equivariant homotopy type is not determined.
Accessible published literature may omit an unindexed equivalent statement.
title: A two-sphere wedge and its full symmetry module for crown-graph two-independence complexes
